definitions.gloss: national politics, national government, affairs of state
definitions.explanation: The political affairs and governance of a nation at the central level, as opposed to local or regional politics. Used in formal and journalistic contexts to discuss national-level political matters.

examples.japanese: {国政|こくせい}{選挙|せんきょ}が{行|おこな}われる。
examples.english: A national election will be held.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{地方|ちほう}{政治|せいじ}から{国政|こくせい}に{進出|しんしゅつ}した。
examples.english: She moved from local politics to national politics.

examples.japanese: {国政|こくせい}に{参加|さんか}するためには、{国民|こくみん}{一人一人|ひとりひとり}が{政治|せいじ}に{関心|かんしん}を{持|も}つことが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: For citizens to participate in national politics, it is important that each individual take an interest in political affairs.

notes:
USAGE:
{国政|こくせい} refers specifically to politics at the national level, distinguishing it from {地方|ちほう}{政治|せいじ} (local politics). It is commonly seen in news and political discourse.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国政|こくせい}{選挙|せんきょ}: national election
- {国政|こくせい}に{参加|さんか}する: to participate in national politics
- {国政|こくせい}に{進出|しんしゅつ}する: to enter national politics
- {国政|こくせい}を{担|にな}う: to bear responsibility for national governance
